text_blocks.snippet: Early signs of Alzheimer's disease include memory loss, particularly forgetting recently learned information, difficulty planning or solving problems, and trouble completing familiar tasks. Other symptoms include confusion about time or place, vision problems, new difficulties with words, misplacing items, and decreased or poor judgment. As the disease progresses, individuals may experience personality and behavior changes, such as increased agitation, paranoia, or hallucinations.
